candidate_blindness_disclosure: This is a post-evaluation migration with the candidate already visible. Discovery, synthesis, independent benchmark review and normalization were reused, not rerun. The policy builder emits freeze.candidate_seen=false for the unchanged candidate-independent standard policy configuration; it is not a claim of a new candidate-blind migration review.
substantive_methodology_changes: Clutter gate excluded: every frozen root-cause/item-family group falls below the 5% threshold. Ordinary architecture deductions retained.

Generic grounding no longer duplicates the Russia stance defect. It independently qualifies on seven major PATH-bound route defects and 207 delivered severe/no-fit locator assignments; localized clutter alone does not gate.
Reliability distributed ceiling count changes from 1183 to 782 after excluding 401 material_mismatch locators. At 5.9499353268% across 15/17 sections the ceiling is 80, formerly 70.
Pooled high-value-treatment-recall ceiling removed; all treatment-recall/F1 deductions remain.
Explicit major delivered severe/no-fit Reliability ceiling triggers at 80 on seven material route defects, tied with the distributed ceiling.
Findability 90 ceiling qualifies on seven, formerly ten, material route defects; score remains 85.66238800735458226610409072, so it is non-binding.
Critical central-omission and major stance consequences retained with frozen severity/retrieval evidence.
Validity is explicitly valid, with zero blockers; publication readiness remains separate.
Partial fit and missing supplemental-route yellow signals explicitly retained.
mechanical_changes: Standard policy rebuilt with new identity and freeze timestamp, same source scope/audience/audit mode and numeric density settings; content policy and density provenance labels move to V8.1.
Benchmark policy and self-hash mechanically rebound; 17 missing-access benchmark hashes and current state bindings updated. Original approval and release provenance untouched.
Only scoring/report stages invalidated and completed through typed score/build-report commands. Ten derived artifacts regenerated; byte-identical collections reused where regenerated bytes agree.
Historical evaluation_id, report_id and compatible filenames/schema names retained; methodology identity comes from policy/rubric/calculation profile, not those labels.
The high_value_treatment_recall_safeguard component changes weight/effective_weight metadata from cap_only to reported_diagnostic_only; its numerator, denominator and normalized value are unchanged.
